package amqpdemo

import (
	"context"

	amqp "github.com/rabbitmq/amqp091-go"
)

func PublishOrder(ch *amqp.Channel) error {
	return ch.Publish("orders.exchange", "order.created", false, false, amqp.Publishing{
		ContentType: "application/json",
		Body:        []byte("{}"),
	})
}

func PublishWithCtx(ctx context.Context, ch *amqp.Channel) error {
	return ch.PublishWithContext(ctx, "billing.exchange", "billing.invoiced", false, false, amqp.Publishing{
		Body: []byte("{}"),
	})
}

func ConsumeOrders(ch *amqp.Channel) (<-chan amqp.Delivery, error) {
	return ch.Consume("orders.queue", "consumer-1", true, false, false, false, nil)
}
